messages:
maria (DevEx PM): quick preflight — we have the devexp release cutover scheduled for Tue 18:00 PT. this thread = single source for owners/blocks for: SDK bump, docs merge, quickstart toggles, sampleapps e2e, and the changelog slice. please update status inline.

maria (DevEx PM): copying checklist (edit statuses):
```
- SDK: bump to v1.4.0 - owner: @arun - status: WIP (packaging failure)
- Docs: client API snippets updated - owner: @liz - status: READY (just needs sampleapp link)
- Quickstarts: toggle default to new flow - owner: @maria - status: STAGED
- SampleApps: e2e & smoke - owner: @tessa - status: FAIL (auth env in CI)
- Changelog: cut slice for public notes - owner: @maria/@liz - status: DRAFT
- Canary: small percentage on hosted + dedicated fallback - owner: @ben - status: PLAN READY
```

arun (SDK Eng): FYI, SDK PR is merged to main but the wheel build is failing on macOS runner. failing step: `python -m build` -> cryptic `dist/*` error. I have a fix in branch arun/wheel-fix, opening PR now. ETA 2h.

liz (Docs): docs PRs are green except the client snippet for the new `Client.new_session()` signature. @tessa can you point me to the sampleapp path that uses sessions so I can update the snippet?

CI-bot: build #4567: SDK main branch - mac-wheel job FAILED -> logs: https://ci.internal/r/4567/artifacts/logs/mac-wheel.log

ci-bot: failing test excerpt:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for redwood-sdk which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```

arun (SDK Eng): thanks, saw the log. packaging fix will update pyproject and add the missing binary dependency. packaging job should pass once PR is merged. will ping.

ben (Release Eng): re: canary — I can flip a 5% traffic route to new release on hosted. Dedicated fallback will be immediate if latency or error rate spikes. I need the canary config file names (service IDs). @maria can you paste the services list? Also re: CI secrets for sampleapps: our dedicated CI runner doesn't have the new REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN scope. I can add it but need approval from security (quick ok?).

maria (DevEx PM): adding services: `devexp-api-prod`, `devexp-embed-prod`, `devexp-dedicated-prod`. @ben please use `devexp-api-prod` for canary. Security: @liz can you confirm quick secret scope ok?

liz (Docs): security ok on that scope for CI tokens (we already have precedent). +1 from me.

jordan (QA): I can run smoke once arun's wheel is available. pls drop the artifact link here. I will run the basic CLI quickstart against canary and report regressions within 3h. tagging @tessa to coordinate sampleapp env.

ci-bot: sampleapp e2e job #890 failed with auth error: `Missing REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN` in environment. logs: https://ci.internal/r/890/logs/e2e.log

tessa (SampleApps): that's expected — we moved the token into vault-scoped secrets last week and the sampleapps repo hasn't been updated to read VAULT_TEST_TOKEN. I'll push a tiny patch to read both envs (REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN fallback to VAULT_TEST_TOKEN). will open PR in 30m.

ben (Release Eng): I can update the CI secret binding for the dedicated runner once tessa's patch lands. will queue the change; ETA 1h after merge.

maria (DevEx PM): nice. contingency: if SDK wheel not ready by cutoff (Tue 18:00 PT), we will ship docs+quickstarts with a compatibility note and hold the sampleapp canonical images. we prefer full rollout but want to be explicit.

arun (SDK Eng): ack. I'll prioritize the wheel. if packaging fix doesn't pass in CI I'll revert the PEP 517 change and publish a temporary wheel under `1.4.0-rc1` and tag you all.

tessa (SampleApps): PR opened -> sampleapps#124 update env reading. tests locally pass. requesting @ben to re-run the e2e on dedicated once secret bound.

ben (Release Eng): queued secret binding, dedicated runner will have token. re-run triggered: e2e #891 -> running.

ci-bot: e2e #891 started -> link: https://ci.internal/r/891/logs/e2e.log

ci-bot: SDK wheel fix PR #782 merged -> artifact: https://ci.internal/r/782/artifacts/redwood-sdk-1.4.0-py3-none-any.whl

jordan (QA): grabbing wheel now, running smoke locally. will post results within 25m.

jordan (QA): smoke: PASS for CLI quickstart, minor warning on `--timeout` default. filing ticket: QA-234. no blocking regressions.

maria (DevEx PM): excellent — that probably unblocks docs merge. @liz please proceed to update snippet and merge changelog draft. deadline for changelog cut: Tue 12:00 PT.

liz (Docs): will merge by 11:30 PT. I'll add a short compatibility note about the `--timeout` behavior and link QA-234.

arun (SDK Eng): published wheel to staging pypi and pinned in quickstart example. PR for quickstarts updated: devexp/quickstart#402.

tessa (SampleApps): e2e #891 -> PASS. sampleapp images build green. I'm kicking new sampleapp release pipeline to produce artifacts.

ben (Release Eng): canary ready. flipping 5% now for `devexp-api-prod`. monitoring dashboards are on. I'll watch error rate and latency for the next 30m and escalate if >0.5% errors or +20ms p50.

ci-bot: canary change applied -> 5% -> https://infra.internal/rollouts/5678

maria (DevEx PM): summary/action items:
- @arun: follow up on any post-publish packaging fallout (ETA: on-call window Mon/Tue).
- @liz: merge docs + changelog by Tue 12:00 PT.
- @tessa: confirm sampleapp artifacts posted to CDN (tag me when done).
- @ben: monitor canary and prepare immediate fallback if thresholds hit.
- @jordan: run regression run after canary stable and report.

maria (DevEx PM): closing note — thanks everyone for quick turn. i'll post an async followup with final release notes links and the rollback playbook once canary completes. :tada: 

arun (SDK Eng): thanks all. ping me if you see install issues. :handshake: 

liz (Docs): merged changelog and docs at 11:14 PT. added compatibility note and QA-234 link.

ben (Release Eng): canary looks healthy at +35m. keeping 5% for another 25m then will scale. no rollback needed so far. :thumbsup: 

jordan (QA): will run full regression against 20% canary next window. will post results.

maria (DevEx PM): awesome — thread closed for now, reopen if something pops.
